original_query: How many major languages are there in the country that has control over mainland China and the largely self-governing territories of Hong Kong (since 1997) and Macau (since 1999)?

confirmed.answer_text: Major Languages: Mandarin, Yue (Cantonese), Wu (Shanghainese), Minbei (Fuzhou), Minnan (Hokkien-Taiwanese), Xiang, Gan, Hakka dialects

consolidated_key_facts: The country controlling mainland China and Hong Kong (since 1997) and Macau (since 1999) is the People's Republic of China.
Major local languages spoken in the region include Mandarin (official), Yue (Cantonese), Wu (Shanghainese), Minbei (Fuzhou), Minnan (Hokkien-Taiwanese), Xiang, Gan, and Hakka dialects.
